choice.basis: The dashboard title is 'Public Service Feedback Share by Category' and the routing criterion is the 'Lowest feedback share'. The percentage inscriptions on the chart provide the explicit share values: Service Quality (52%), Service Cost (51%), Service Design (12%), Support Access (17%), Service Delivery (42%), and Other (41%). Although the vertical positions of the markers on the 'Value' axis are inconsistent with these percentages (e.g., the 12% marker is higher than the 41% marker), the explicit percentage labels are the authoritative source for the 'share' mentioned in the title. The lowest share is 12%, corresponding to the 'Service Design' category. Therefore, 'Service Design' should be routed to the low-feedback coverage follow-up workflow.
choice.option_label: Route Service Design to low-feedback coverage follow-up
